officialText:
The owner of a small wind turbine or small wind turbine tower, as such terms are defined in chapter 2 of the New York city building code, shall maintain such turbine and tower in accordance with department rules.

(L.L. 2018/105, 5/26/2018, eff. 11/22/2018; Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
